historical_executions.label: Whisper tiny.en plus MFA on one 15 s AMI crop
historical_executions.scope: One English meeting crop evaluated once; the AMI timing reference is itself forced alignment and was not manually corrected. The reported 11.76% WER is four errors over 34 words and is not a general ASR accuracy, accent, language, noise or device result. No audio, weight or runtime is loaded here; not rerun by this survey.

historical_executions.label: Paired Whisper tiny.en fixed-scorer screen on ten AMI crops
historical_executions.scope: Ten short clips from one meeting and 136 reference words; Whisper is the fixed scorer for time-scaled audio. The high source WER and per-clip variation limit interpretation, and no confidence interval or listening panel exists. not rerun by this survey.

historical_executions.label: Whisper tiny.en int8 sherpa-onnx transcript-drift scorer
historical_executions.scope: Offline scoring only; the scorer is outside the playback chain. Two of three clips are synthetic TTS and the real clip has no reference transcript, so the WER proxy does not establish comprehension, naturalness or a recognition result. not rerun by this survey.

historical_executions.label: Vosk small-en-us-0.15 content-gate boundary screen
historical_executions.scope: Construction-time block labels on two TTS clips; the gate is adequate only for coarse 100 ms policy and would be a poor production boundary source. There is no reference transcript, speaker label or recognition score. not rerun by this survey.
